description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerTransaction controller class for the OpenCart admin interface. It handles displaying, saving, and generating reports related to customer transactions within the admin panel, including methods for rendering views, processing form submissions, and retrieving transaction data with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: CustomerTransaction
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer transaction reports in the OpenCart admin extension. Provides methods to display report forms, save settings, and generate transaction reports with filtering.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the report form view with necessary data, including breadcrumbs, configuration options, and common page components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving report settings via POST, checks permissions, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates and displays the customer transaction report view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the transaction list, primarily invoking getReport method.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares customer transaction data with filtering, pagination, and view rendering.
